customer_name: Beijing Yilian Tongda Technology Co., Ltd.
business_problem: Yilian Tongda needed a safer and more efficient way to help power-industry staff work with scattered standards, maintenance records, inspection documents and risk-control knowledge that were difficult to search and keep consistent.
solution_summary: Yilian Tongda used Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan platforms to turn fragmented power-sector documents and operating records into a governed enterprise assistant. The architecture combines a retrieval-augmented generation layer, enterprise permissions, scenario constraints and agent-style integration so the system can work with text, tables, images, structured data and real-time information instead of only answering from one knowledge base. In the target workflow, employees query compliance rules, safety requirements, equipment drawings, calibration records and technical-supervision materials through a single assistant, while the agent layer connects to existing enterprise systems without invasive rework. This lets the platform serve multiple roles at once: it standardizes compliance knowledge, guides risk-control execution, exposes equipment diagrams for field maintenance, and converts archived documents into operational knowledge rather than passive storage. The result is a domain-specific copilot for energy operations rather than a generic chatbot.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages the power-industry assistant workflows and integrates them with enterprise systems.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development environment used for the domain assistant.

solution_components.name: RAG Engine
solution_components.role: Retrieves and generates answers across text, tables, images and structured information.

solution_components.name: Agent Technology
solution_components.role: Connects the assistant to existing enterprise systems in a non-invasive way.

data_flow: Standards, records, drawings and enterprise-system data are indexed through the RAG layer; staff questions invoke the Qianfan-based assistant, which retrieves the relevant materials and returns governed answers inside the enterprise workflow.
business_outcome: Yilian Tongda built a reusable energy-industry assistant that improves compliance, maintenance search, safety execution and knowledge reuse without forcing customers to replatform existing systems.
